info.name: JoodPakPaw V2 Core API
info.description:
Enterprise Postman Collection for JoodPakPaw V2 API Server (Sprint 0 - Sprint 4).
Enforces Single Standard Envelope (`data` wrapper), `camelCase` DTOs, and OWASP Security.

item.name: 00 - Health & Discovery (PASS)
item.description: Core system status and discovery endpoints (Sprint 0 - Verified)

request.description: Check root service identification.
Probe system uptime and database connectivity (Supabase PostgreSQL).
List all active API v1 subsystem endpoints.
Verify 404 error handler adheres to JoodPakPaw standard API contract.

item.name: 01 - Auth & User Profile (Enterprise V2 - PASS)
item.description: JWT Authentication, OTP Registration, Single Envelope Data Wrapper, Password Reset, Profile, WebP Avatar, and Sign-out APIs

body.raw:
{
  "email": "new.guest@joodpakpaw.com",
  "password": "Password123!",
  "confirmPassword": "Password123!",
  "firstName": "สมหวัง",
  "lastName": "รักสัตว์",
  "phone": "0899876543"
}

request.description: Register a new user and generate 6-digit OTP + refCode. Returns T-2007 on validation error, A-3003 on duplicate email, A-3004 on duplicate phone.
Verify 6-digit OTP and issue JWT accessToken & refreshToken.
Generate new 6-digit OTP and refCode for user.
Sign in as Admin. Saves `jwt_token`, `refresh_token`, and `user_id` to environment. Returns A-3001 (401) on invalid credentials.
Sign in as verified Host with demo seed account.
Rotate/issue a new accessToken from a valid refreshToken.
Request password reset token. Returns DB-1002 (404) if email is not registered.
Reset password using token. Returns A-3010 (400) if token is expired or already used.
Fetch authenticated user profile (`ProfileResponse`), roles, and verification status.
Change password for authenticated user via context-aware route. Returns A-3011 on wrong oldPassword, A-3012 if newPassword equals oldPassword, and invalidates active refresh tokens.

formdata.description: Optional profile image (automatically resized and converted to .webp on S3/MinIO)

request.description: Update user profile fields and upload avatar image (auto-converted to .webp via sharp + @aws-sdk/client-s3). Returns A-3004 (409) on duplicate phone, T-2007 (400) on invalid phone, and A-3007 (403) on IDOR attempt.
Sign out and revoke active refresh tokens.
